the Hall and magnetoresistivity coefficients are positive, that they are both linear in the magnetic field strength at low magnetic fields, that the Hall coefficient is proportional to the mobility, and that the magnetoresistivity coefficient is proportional to a quantity called the Hall mobility.
the electron distribution in an undoped heterostructure is nondegenerate and that the magnetoresistance is dominated by the polar optical phonon scattering mechanism.
the electron mobility is reduced in the presence of a magnetic field and that the magnetoresistance is anisotropic, with a maximum at an angle to the current of about 60 degrees.

the low-field galvano-magnetic transport in a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) confined to the GaA side of an n-type modulation doped AlGaAs / GaAs heterojunction.
the study of the transport properties of a two-dimensional (2D) electron system in an AlGaAs/Gas heterojunction, in the low-field limit.
